title: phlox kelseyi subsp. salina
intro: Phlox kelseyi subsp. salina, commonly known as Kelseyi phlox, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Polemoniaceae. This plant is known for its fragrant, pink to purple flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
